description: One nine storey and one twelve storey buildings for business use (Use class B1) associated plant, standby generators and compactors, landscaping, servicing and access arrangements, together with the reconfiguration of the approved car parking layout
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Conditions valid for both buildings and surrounding areas
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - A scheme of phasing of development shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No fans, louvres, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - 17.	Prior to first occupation of any floorspace, a green travel plan shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing. This green travel plan shall be implemented upon occupation of either Building 6 or Building 7, whichever is first occupied, and thereafter maintained and updated as necessary
Condition : 7 - Conditions relating to Building 6

Condition : 8 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the office building hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 9 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0730 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1700 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - Before commencement of operations, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority to cover the following matters:

(i)	any external illumination of the site

(ii)	measures to ensure that all mud and other loose materials are not carried on the wheels and chassis of any vehicles leaving the site; and

(iii)	measures to minimise dust nuisance caused by the operations and to ensure that no dust or other debris is carried on to the adjoining properties.

The scheme so approved should be fully implemented.

Condition : 11 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 12 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - No development shall take place until full details of both hard and soft landscape works have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include proposed finished levels or contours; means of enclosure; car parking layouts; other vehicle and pedestrian access and circulation areas; hard surfacing material; minor artefacts and structures (eg. furniture, refuse or other storage units, signs, lighting etc); 

Soft landscape works shall include (planting plans; written specifications (including cultivation and other operations associated with plant and grass establishment); schedules of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities where appropriate; implementation programme)

Condition : 14 - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.  The works shall be carried out prior to the occupation of any part of the development or in accordance with the programme agreed with the local planning authority

Condition : 15 - No development shall take place until details of earthworks have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  These details shall include the proposed grading and mounding of land areas including the levels and contours to be formed, showing the relationship of proposed mounding to existing vegetation and surrounding land form.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.

Condition : 16 - 13.	 Development shall not commence until a survey of the existing ground levels has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The ground levels as approved shall not be raised or otherwise altered from those shown on the submitted plan, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 17 - Before the development is commenced  details of the internal road giving access to the parking and servicing areas to the rear of building 6 shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  The offices shall not be occupied until the access road has been completed in accordance with details approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 18 - Before the development commences details of parking (including spaces for people with disabilities) shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the spaces shown on the approved drawings no 1459/RRP1459-MA-U-001 Revision 5 and 1452/06-GA-001F shall be available for use before first occupation of Building 6
Condition : 19 - The highest part of the roof of Building 6 (excluding plant) hereby permitted shall not exceed 50.23m AOD.

Condition : 33 - Reason for Approval
The scheme, subject to the proposed legal agreement, complies with the locational, employment and transport policies of the London Plan, and the policies in the Councils Unitary Development Plan relating to new development, employment and transport.  The overall sustainable employment benefits of the scheme to the West London region are considered to outweigh any limited loss of amenity to neighbouring properties.
